During the [[War in Kryta]], [[Divinity Coast (explorable area)|Divinity Coast]] is the location of [[Zinn]]'s laboratory. Built near some old crypts, the lab is kept secret from [[Peacekeeper]]s by locals while Zinn busily works on new ways to fight the [[Mursaat]].

== Getting there ==
This area can only be entered by taking the [[Secret River Passage]] in [[Talmark Wilderness (War in Kryta)]]; the passage appears ''after'' you have watched the dialogue of Livia recruiting Zinn to the ''War in Kryta''.

==Shrines==
This map contains no resurrection shrines or god statues; however, the Asuran Lab acts as a shrine, even though there is no visual indication for that. This can be a pain if a member of your party has a condition and dies after being resurrected you cannot resurrect them with a skill because of the effect [[Loose Magic]].

==Notes==
*All creatures near Zinn's lab are inflicted with [[Loose Magic]] every three seconds.
**Loose Magic disenchants and prevents skill use, so if a party member dies near Zinn's lab (e.g. from [[health degeneration]]) only [["By Ural's Hammer!"]], [["We Shall Return!"]], [[Lively Was Naomei]] or a [[wipe]] will be able to resurrect them.
*There are no [[hard mode]] tasks to complete in this area; it cannot be [[vanquish]]ed.
*After the [[War in Kryta]] is finished, you can still travel back here and there will be no enemies. You can't enter the lab, but this otherwise makes it easy to map this area for [[cartographer]].

==Trivia== 
*This is the region in which the city known as Divinity's Reach will be founded in Guild Wars 2.
